metadata.title: FinPilot: make sense of where your money goes
metadata.description: Track income and expenses, plan budgets, and split trip costs with friends. No bank connection needed.

shell.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark theme

home.title: Project foundation
home.description: FinPilot is under active development. This page confirms that the web app and API are connected. No financial features exist yet.

hero.title: Make sense of where your money goes.
hero.lede: FinPilot helps you track income and expenses, plan budgets, and split trip costs with friends. You record everything yourself, with no bank connection.
hero.assure: Sign in with your Google account. FinPilot never sees your Google password, and never holds or moves your money.

preview.caption: Illustrative preview of the FinPilot app.

story.title: Your money, your story
story.lede: Follow one month. Every stop is something you recorded, and the balance moves with it.
story.end: Every number traces back to something you recorded.

record.title: Every expense has a place
record.lede: Type the amount. FinPilot fills in the rest: today's date, your default account, and the category you used last.

points.one: Often the amount is all you need to type.
points.two: Amounts are read the way your language writes them.

record.added: {amount} added to {category} in this example. Nothing is saved.

demo.title: Try it
demo.invalid: That doesn't look like an amount. Use digits, with up to two decimals.
demo.disclaimer: Interactive demo. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.

plan.title: Plan without the guesswork
plan.lede: Give each category a monthly limit, and see how much of it you've used at a glance.

benefits.one: A monthly limit for each category.
benefits.two: What's left, always one glance away.
benefits.three: Overspending spotted early, with the reason behind it.

trip.title: Three friends, one fair split
trip.lede: Everyone records what they paid. FinPilot works out each share and suggests simple payments to even things out.
trip.balanceNote: Everyone's share is {share}. Paying more than that puts you ahead.
trip.confirm: Payments happen outside FinPilot, in cash or by bank transfer, and each one is confirmed in the app.
trip.disclaimer: FinPilot calculates who owes whom. It never holds or transfers money.

0.title: Deniz, Lina, and Sami
0.body: Three friends start a trip to Cappadocia. Everyone sees the same expenses.

1.title: Sami books the hotel
1.body: €360 for two nights. Split three ways, that's €120 each.

2.title: Deniz pays for the balloon ride
2.body: The big one: €450 at sunrise, €150 each.

3.title: Lina covers dinner
3.body: €90 in Göreme. The trip total is now €900.

4.title: Who's ahead, who's behind
4.body: Each share is €300. Deniz paid €150 more than that, Sami €60 more, and Lina €210 less.

5.title: Two payments settle everything
5.body: Lina pays Deniz €150 and Sami €60. FinPilot suggested these payments; you make them your usual way.

reports.title: Reports and insights
reports.lede: Monthly summaries you can filter, export, and print.
reports.caption: Illustrative preview. The switches filter sample data.

summaries.title: Monthly summaries
summaries.body: Income, spending, and balances for each currency, never mixed.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: By period, account, category, currency, or type, with trip shares in or out.

export.title: PDF and CSV export
export.body: Share a clean PDF, or take the rows into a spreadsheet.

print.title: Printable reports
print.body: A print layout with no buttons or navigation, in your language.

final.body: Start with one expense. The route draws itself from there.

journey.title: From payday to a better plan

income.title: Your salary arrives
income.body: Record income as it lands, so the month starts from a clear number.
income.label: Salary

expenses.title: Expenses find their place
expenses.body: Every expense goes into its category, from rent to a coffee.

insights.title: See where it went
insights.body: The picture gets clear: what took the biggest share of this month.

planning.title: Plan a better month
planning.body: Set realistic limits for next month, based on what you actually spent.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lead: Every place your money lives. Balances are worked out from what you've recorded.
accounts.missing: This account doesn't exist, or it isn't yours.

overview.title: Overview
overview.separate: Each currency has its own total. FinPilot never adds different currencies together.

empty.title: Add your first account
empty.body: Start with the places your money actually is: your wallet, a bank account, your savings. FinPilot never connects to a bank; you record everything yourself.

done.madeDefault: New entries will use this account.

form.createLead: Manually tracked. Nothing connects to a bank.
form.name: Name
form.currencyHint: Can't be changed after the account is created.
form.openingHint: Optional. What the account holds today; leave it empty for zero.
form.fixedFields: The type and currency of an account can't be changed.

adjust.title: Adjust balance
adjust.lead: If what's really there differs from FinPilot, enter the real amount. FinPilot records the difference; nothing earlier is changed.
adjust.reasonHint: Optional. For example: counted the cash.
adjust.notIncome: An adjustment isn't counted as income or spending, and it stays in the account's history.
adjust.noChange: That's already the recorded balance. There's nothing to adjust.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.lead: Move recorded money between your own accounts. It isn't counted as income or spending.
transfer.receivedHint: What arrived in {currency}, after any conversion.
transfer.rateNote: FinPilot never guesses an exchange rate. This one comes from the two amounts you entered.
transfer.rateConfirm: This rate matches what I actually got.
transfer.needTwo: You need two active accounts to transfer between them.

archive.title: Archive <bdi>{name}</bdi>?
archive.body: Archived accounts are hidden from your overview and can't receive new entries. Their history is kept, and you can restore them.
archive.restoreBody: It returns to your overview and can receive new entries again.
archive.nonZeroBody: Only an account at zero can be archived, so your totals always add up. Move the money to another account, or adjust the balance to zero if it's really empty.

transactions.lead: Everything you've recorded, newest first. Nothing is ever deleted: corrected and voided entries stay in the history.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: How your entries are grouped. Rename the defaults, add your own, and archive what you don't use; past entries keep their category.
categories.settingsLead: Rename, add, or archive the categories you choose from in Quick Add.
categories.archivedNote: Archived categories stay on past entries but can't be chosen for new ones.

groups.archiveConfirm: Archive {name}? Its categories become ungrouped; no amounts change.
groups.rule: Groups only organise categories. Each category is in one group at most, so group totals add up to your spending exactly.

categories.deleteBody: Only a category you added and never used can be deleted.

fx.unsupported: There's no reference rate from {from} to {to}. Enter the amount charged, or your own rate.

equivalent.lead: Roughly what an amount is worth in other currencies, gold, or Bitcoin. For information only: nothing is recorded.
equivalent.enterAmount: Enter an amount to see its equivalents.
equivalent.failed: Equivalents couldn't be loaded. Try again shortly.
equivalent.disclaimer: Indicative only: daily reference rates for currencies and gold, an indicative market price for Bitcoin. Not a price you can buy or sell at, and not a holding.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.lead: Money you expect regularly: salary, rent, bills, installments. Nothing counts until you confirm it happened.
recurring.confirmed: Recorded. It now counts in your balances and totals.

empty.title: Nothing recurring yet
empty.body: Add your salary, rent, or a monthly bill. FinPilot reminds you when it's due and records it only when you confirm.

sections.comingEmpty: Nothing expected in the next five weeks.

form.lead: Changes apply from now on; what's already confirmed or skipped stays as it was.
form.needsDebt: Add a debt first, then its installments.
form.name: Name
form.windowHint: Days past the end of a month fall on its last day: 31 becomes 30 April and 28 or 29 February.
form.weeklyHint: Expected on the same weekday as the start date.
form.remindDays: {count, plural, =0 {When it's due} one {# day before} other {# days before}}
form.expectedOnly: This only describes what you expect. Nothing is recorded until you confirm it.

confirm.leadVariable: Record the amount that actually arrived or left.
confirm.amountHint: Change it if it wasn't exactly as expected.
confirm.onlyNow: This records one real transaction. You can void it later if it was a mistake.

debts.title: Debts
debts.note: Borrowing isn't income and repaying isn't spending: debts never change your income or spending totals.

form.title: Add a debt
form.lead: Money you borrowed or lent. What remains is worked out from the repayments you record.
form.movedIn: Yes, it arrived in one of my accounts
form.movedOut: Yes, it left one of my accounts
form.before: No, this debt existed before FinPilot
form.noInterest: FinPilot doesn't add interest or fees. Record any extra charge separately.

payment.notSpending: A repayment isn't spending, so it won't change your spending totals.
payment.notIncome: Money paid back isn't income, so it won't change your income totals.

recurring.deleteBody: Only for something set up by mistake, with no payment ever recorded. Its expected payments go too; no money moves.
recurring.endBody: No new payments will be expected. Payments already recorded stay as they are.

rejected.group: Thousands separators are added for you. Use “{decimal}” for decimals.
rejected.paste: That isn't a clear amount in this language, so it wasn't used.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.lead: A monthly limit per category, or for all spending. Only real expenses count.
budgets.emptyBody: Set a limit for a category, like Groceries, or for all your spending. It applies from the month you choose.
budgets.rules: Spent counts posted expenses in the budget's currency only. Income, transfers, opening balances, adjustments and debts never count. Corrections and voids update the month they belong to.
budgets.notCountedShort: {count, plural, one {another currency not counted} other {# other currencies not counted}}

archived.title: Archived budgets
archived.lead: Ended before or in this month. Earlier months still show them.

form.title: New budget
form.lead: A limit applies from the month you choose. Earlier months keep their own limits.
form.allSpendingHint: Every expense in this currency counts toward the limit.
form.currencyHint: Only spending in this currency counts. Other currencies are shown but never converted.
form.alertHint: From this share of the limit the budget shows as approaching. Default 80.
form.alertInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.
form.fromHint: Applies to {month} and every month after, until you change it.

detail.alertAt: Shows as approaching at {percent}% of the limit.
detail.notCounted: Also spent in this category in other currencies, not counted: <amounts></amounts>.
detail.archiveHint: The budget stops from this month. Earlier months keep it, and you can restore it later.

detail.noTransactions: No expenses count toward this budget in this month.

detail.tripShares: {count, plural, one {# trip share} other {# trip shares}}
detail.tripSharesNote: Your share of approved trip expenses in this category. It counts in the budget even when someone else paid.
detail.deleteBody: Only for a budget set up by mistake. It's removed completely; your spending isn't touched. If earlier months used it, archive it from this month instead.
detail.hasHistory: Earlier months use this budget, so it can't be deleted. Archive it from {month} instead: earlier months keep it, and you can restore it later.

insights.title: Insights
insights.lead: Where your money went, from your own records. One currency at a time.
insights.emptyTitle: Nothing to show for this period
insights.emptyBody: Record income or expenses, or choose a longer period.
insights.separate: You have money in more than one currency. Each is shown on its own and never added together.
insights.monthlyNote: Months up to the end of the chosen period.
insights.monthlyAria: Bar chart of income and spending per month in {currency}. The table view lists every value.
insights.trendAria: Line chart of spending over the period in {currency}. The table view lists every value.
insights.rules: Spending is posted expenses; income is posted income. Transfers, conversions between your accounts, opening balances, adjustments and debt amounts are never counted. Amounts in other currencies are never converted.

kpi.transactionsHint: Every type, including transfers, adjustments and debts

groups.title: By category group
groups.note: The same totals as the categories, grouped. Nothing is counted twice.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: A full statement for any period. Filter it, export it as PDF or CSV, or print it.
reports.separate: Each currency is reported on its own. Amounts are never converted or added together.

period.label: Period
period.invalid: The start date is after the end date.

filters.searchHint: Narrows the transaction list only; totals cover the whole period.

export.rateLimited: Too many exports in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.

export.printing: Preparing the complete report to print…

export.busy: Too many PDFs are being made right now. Try again in a moment.

summary.title: Summary
summary.netDefinition: Net is income minus spending, and spending includes your trip shares. It isn't cash flow: cash, including money paid into trips and received back, is reconciled under Balances. Transfers, conversions, opening balances, adjustments and debts aren't income or spending either.
summary.balancesHidden: Opening and closing balances aren't shown while a type or category filter is on, because they'd leave out other movements.
summary.scope: Totals cover the selected period and filters. The description search only narrows the transaction list below.

balances.doesNotReconcile: Balances don't reconcile. Please report this.

categories.note: Share of spending, with the previous period of the same length for comparison.

breakdown.title: Over time

breakdown.empty: No income or spending in {currency} in this period.

trips.title: Trips
trips.lead: Share expenses with the people you travel with, in any currency, and see who owes whom.
trips.emptyBody: Create a trip, invite the people going, and record what each of you pays.
trips.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}
trips.privacy: Everyone on a trip sees its expenses. Your accounts, balances and personal transactions are never shared.

record.sameCurrencyHint: As recorded in the trip. Change it if your statement differs.

lead.expense_changed: The expense changed from {was} to {now}. Your account wasn't changed.

lead.settlement_reversed: This payment was reversed in the trip. Your account wasn't changed.

reverse.hint: As if it was never recorded.

done.convert: Unlinked; kept as a plain entry.

approve.open: Approve and record in my account
approve.lead: Approves it and records the cash in one of your accounts. Only you see which.
approve.incomplete: Choose an account and the amount charged.

report.privacy: Trip figures only. No one's personal accounts, balances or transactions are part of this report.

report.pdfPartial: PDF ready, marked PARTIAL: it lists {included} of {total} expenses. The CSV has every row.

trips.cancelBody: Nothing is deleted: its expenses, payments and balances stay, and payments can still be settled. No new expenses can be added until it's reinstated.

plan.title: Plan
plan.failed: The plan can't be shown right now.
plan.empty: Nothing planned yet. Add where you'll stay, how you'll travel, or ideas.
plan.explainer: Estimates and deposits here are for planning only. Spending counts once an expense is recorded and approved.
plan.lead: Shared with everyone on the trip. Only what you need: no passport or card details.
plan.datesInvalid: The end is before the start.
plan.estimatedHint: In the trip's currency. Not spending.
plan.depositHint: Record it as an expense to count it.
plan.referenceHint: Only the code. No card or passport numbers.

analytics.plannedNote: Planned is the plan's estimates; spent is approved expenses only.

trips.archiveBody: Trips can't be deleted: their expenses and payments are shared history with the other members. Archiving makes it read-only and hides it; you can unarchive it later.

templates.title: Quick templates
templates.lead: Shortcuts for things you record often. A template only fills in Quick Add; nothing is saved until you press Save.
templates.emptyBody: Create one here, or open any expense and choose “Save as template”.
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the template “{name}”? Your transactions aren't affected.
templates.rule: Templates are shortcuts, not schedules. For something that repeats on a date, use Recurring.
templates.formLead: Choosing a template opens Quick Add with these details and today's date.
templates.name: Name
templates.amountHint: Leave it empty to type the amount each time.
templates.incomplete: Give it a name and a category, and check the amount.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: Your spending, income and expected payments, day by day, in one currency at a time.
calendar.due: {count, plural, one {# payment due} other {# payments due}}
calendar.currencyNote: Amounts in {currency}. Other currencies are shown separately, never added together.
calendar.future: This day hasn't come yet. Expected payments are shown; nothing is recorded in advance.
calendar.installmentsNote: Expected from the plan's schedule. It counts as paid only when you record the payment.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.lead: Targets you're saving towards, with progress you track yourself.
goals.notMoney: Goal progress is a figure you keep track of. It isn't money in an account, isn't added to any balance, and nothing is moved between accounts.
goals.emptyBody: Set a target, like a new laptop, and add to it as you save.
goals.formLead: A goal tracks progress you enter yourself; it never holds or moves money.
goals.name: Name
goals.startingHint: Counts as the first progress entry.
goals.incomplete: Give it a name and an amount.

goals.historyLead: Every change, kept as it happened.

event.created: Goal created with a target of {target}

goals.followsPlan: Follows <link>{name}</link>: progress is what you've paid ahead of schedule.
goals.archiveBody: Goals aren't deleted: their history is kept. Archiving hides this one; you can restore it any time. No money moves either way.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.lead: Monthly and yearly services, from your recurring payments. Each payment counts only when you confirm it.

subscriptions.costsNote: Active subscriptions only, per currency. Yearly ones are spread over twelve months (≈).
subscriptions.confirmNote: Nothing is marked paid by itself. Confirm a payment once it has been taken.
subscriptions.cancelConfirm: Cancel {name}? Past payments stay; no new ones will be expected.
subscriptions.created: Subscription added. You'll be asked to confirm each payment.
subscriptions.emptyBody: Add Netflix, your phone plan or cloud storage to see what they cost each month and year.

subscriptions.deleteBody: Only for a subscription added by mistake, with no payment ever recorded. To stop one you've paid, cancel it instead: its history stays.

confirm.failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed.

installments.title: Installments
installments.lead: Purchases and loans you pay back on a schedule. A payment counts only when you record it.
installments.failed: Your plans can't be shown right now.
installments.failedOne: This plan can't be shown right now.
installments.emptyBody: Add a car, a phone or a loan to see what's left, what's due next and when it ends.
installments.rules: How it counts: a purchase counts once as spending, in the month you bought it. Paying back the principal is never spending again. Interest and fees are spending, in "Interest & fees". The schedule never moves money by itself.
installments.paidBeforeNote: {count, plural, one {# installment was} other {# installments were}} paid before this plan was added to FinPilot.

spendingNote.purchase: The full price counted as spending once, on the purchase date. Only the down payment left your account then.
spendingNote.loan: The loan arrived in your account. It isn't income, and paying it back isn't spending.
spendingNote.existing: Recorded later: only what remained was added, so nothing counted as spending.

installments.overdueNotice: {count, plural, one {# installment is} other {# installments are}} past due. Record the payment when you've made it, or reschedule.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.caption: Installments, oldest first

payments.title: Payment history
payments.explain: Voiding a payment in Transactions undoes it here too.

installments.rescheduledNotice: Rescheduled. The old dates are kept in the history.

goal.label: Savings goal

trips.title: Trip spending
trips.lead: Your share of trip costs is your spending. The cash you paid is separate, and settlements are never counted.
trips.cashNote: Not spending: part of it may be other people's share

equivalent.title: Indicative total in {currency}
equivalent.lead: Every currency's spending, in both periods, valued at the same latest reference rates. A change here is spending, not the exchange rate. Past entries aren't revalued.
equivalent.incomplete: A rate is missing, so no combined figure is shown. Each currency stays exact.
equivalent.stale: Some rates are older than usual.

method.title: How these figures are worked out
method.spending: Spending is the same figure as Reports: expenses plus your trip shares, less refunds. Transfers, debts and settlements are never spending.
method.comparable: A comparable period is the same calendar position earlier. A day that doesn't exist there moves to that month's last day.
method.percent: A percentage is only shown when your records cover the whole comparable period and it had spending.
method.pace: Pace uses calendar days. Your usual pace averages the same days of up to three earlier months. The month-end estimate assumes the current average continues.
method.fixed: The parts of spending never overlap, so they always add up to the total.
method.currency: Figures are exact per currency and never added together unless you choose an indicative currency.
method.detail: A category's growth is only ranked if it was at least {share}% of comparable spending, so tiny amounts can't show huge percentages.

legal.title: Privacy notice and beta terms (draft)
legal.metaDescription: How FinPilot's private beta handles your information. A working draft.
legal.draft: This is a working draft for FinPilot's private beta. It hasn't been reviewed by a lawyer, and it doesn't claim compliance with any law. Until a reviewed version is published, FinPilot accepts new accounts only by invitation.

operator.heading: Who runs FinPilot
operator.body: FinPilot is a personal project by Hisham Jouda, run on a private server. It isn't a bank or a payment service, and it never moves money.

collected.heading: What is collected
collected.body: From Google, when you sign in: your name, email address, profile picture and Google account ID. What you enter: accounts, transactions, budgets, trips and the other records you create. To keep your account safe: session records with your browser's description and when it was used, and a security log of sign-ins and important changes.

notCollected.heading: What isn't collected
notCollected.body: No passwords (Google handles sign-in), no bank logins, no card details, and no advertising or analytics trackers.

use.heading: How it's used
use.body: Only to run FinPilot for you: showing, calculating and exporting your own records, keeping your account secure, and fixing faults. Your information isn't sold, shared for advertising, or used to train models.

others.heading: Who else is involved
others.body: Google, for sign-in. Cloudflare, which carries the site's traffic to the server. Public exchange-rate services, which receive only currency codes and dates, never your records.

storage.heading: Where it's kept, and for how long
storage.body: Your records are stored on the operator's server, in a database that keeps each person's records apart. Encrypted backups are kept for up to six months. When you delete your account, your records are removed from the live database; copies in backups disappear as those backups expire.

choices.heading: Your choices
choices.body: You can export your records as CSV or PDF, and delete your account at any time in Settings, under Privacy.

beta.heading: Beta terms
beta.body: The beta is offered as it is, without guarantees, and it may change or stop. Don't rely on FinPilot as your only record of anything important. Nothing in FinPilot is financial advice.

contact.heading: Questions
contact.body: Send questions or requests to the person who invited you, or to the operator through the profiles linked at the bottom of the home page.
